noun_data.noun_definition: A space is a character used to separate words and enhance readability in text.
noun_data.noun_summary: In the function, spaces are used to replace line breaks in a given text, ensuring that the text remains continuous and readable without abrupt interruptions.

noun_data.noun_definition: Dynamic spacing refers to the variable distance or gaps that can be adjusted based on certain conditions or parameters in a user interface.
noun_data.noun_summary: In the function, dynamic spacing is used to insert variable gaps between emoji categories in the emoji picker, enhancing visual separation and organization based on the presence of header emojis.

noun_data.noun_definition: A cursor space is an empty character position in a text where a user can input or modify content.
noun_data.noun_summary: In the function, the cursor space is managed to ensure that when an emoji is replaced in the text, a space is added after the emoji if the next character is not already a space, preventing double spaces and maintaining proper text formatting.

noun_data.noun_definition: White space is a character or series of characters that represent a space in text, typically used to separate words or elements.
noun_data.noun_summary: The function inserts a white space character at a specified index in a given text string, effectively creating a separation between the text segments before and after the index.
